4279-6026-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6026-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-7399.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4640-5147-7082--201.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

643-2624-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Oketra.
As God-Eternal Oketra is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Michelangelo and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2556-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Mnemonic Wall
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Mnemonic Wall
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3899-4552-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

5226-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2893-3470-5478-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2525-3358-6965.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2060-3771-4415-6930.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-3771-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Animar and Spider-Man India trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spider-Man India trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
2060-3771-4415-6930.notes: You may begin the combo with fewer counters on Animar. If Animar has exactly one counter, you must supply {1} extra. If Animar has none, you must supply {3} extra.

1987-2585-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-2811-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
2034-2811-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1478-2018-4053.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability.
Repeat.

101-3941-4067-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

2719-5147-5756.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1322-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
1322-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-5663.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5663.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2232-5653-5654-5655.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Auras.
2232-5653-5654-5655.description:
Cast Ugin's Mastery by paying {0} due to Pearl-Ear.
When Ugin's Mastery enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Case of the Shattered Pact from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Case of the Shattered Pact by paying {0} due to Pearl-Ear.
When Case of the Shattered Pact enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Shattered Pact trigger, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ugin's Mastery from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-2829-5034-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5034-5131.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sol Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1558-1692-2567-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Avenger of Zendikar.
You control at least four lands.
1558-1692-2567-3263.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar with haste.
The Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2724-3987-4428.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Thassa. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
